(Pre) 1992 Ans. (d) Easter is a festival of Christians celebrating the resurrection of Jesus Christ on the third day after his cruciﬁ xion. 92. Which Christian saint is famous for the love with animal and birds? (a) Saint Paul (b) Saint Thomas (c) Saint Francis of Assisi (d) Saint Peter M.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 1997 Ans. (c) Saint Francis of Assisi (1181 or 82-1226 A.D.) is famous for his love of birds and animals. 93. Why is Good Friday of Christians celebrated? (a) Jesus Christ had died (b) Jesus Christ was born (c) Jesus Christ cruciﬁ ed (d) AD was introduced U.P. P.C.S. (Pre) 1990 Ans. (c) Good Friday is celebrated as martyrs’ day of Jesus Christ. According to the Bible, Jesus Christ was hanged on Friday. Mughal Dynasty : Babur *The Mughal rulers belonged to Chagatai branch of Turks. Which derived its name after the second son of Genghis Khan, ruler of central Asia and Turkistan. *The Full name of Babur was Zahiruddin Muhammad Babur. He was born on February 14, 1483 to Umar Shaikh Mirza and Qutlugh Nigar Khanum at Ferghana. After the death of his father, he ascended the throne of Ferghana on June, 1494 as eleven years and four month old minor. *Shaibani Khan invaded Ferghana in 1501 A.D. and defeated Babur at battel of Sar-e-Pul. Babur ﬂ ed to central-Asia. “Tulghuma” technique of Uzbegs was used by Shaybani Khan in the Battle of Sar-e-Pul in which Babur was defeated. *After winning Kabul in 1504 A.D. Babur renounced his ancestral title “Mirza” and assumed new title, “Padshah”. *Alam Khan was the uncle of Ibrahim Lodhi. He invited Babur to invade India, claiming his right to the Delhi throne. *In 1524 A.D., during the 4th campaign of Babur, there was a bitter feud between Sultan Ibrahim Lodi of Delhi and Daulat Khan, the governor of Punjab. Ibrahim Lodi ordered Daulat Khan to visit his capital but Daulat Khan violated his orders and sent his son Dilawar Khan to Babur with a message to help him to dethrone Ibrahim Lodi and enthrone Alam Khan in place of him. It was a golden opportunity for Babur as he had already received the invitation of Rana Sanga, the king of Mewar. He was quite assured that the opportunity to conquer India has come. *The ﬁ rst Battle of Panipat was fought between Babur and Ibrahim Lodi on 21 April, 1526. Babur possessed speciﬁ c military tactics. The vast artillery of Babur was one of the main reasons behind his victory. The army of Ibrahim Lodi lost the battle despite being more in numbers. Ibrahim Lodi was killed in this battle. As a result, the entire area up to Delhi and Agra came under Babur’s control. *Babur declared himself the ruler on April 27, 1526 and founded the Mughal empire in India. Babur used Tulughma war technique in the ﬁ rst battle of Panipat. The huge artillery of Babur was one of the main reasons behind his victory. Ustad Ali Quli led the artillery and Mustafa commended the battalion of gunners. Babur's generosity, earned him the title of “Qalandar”. Cannons were used for the ﬁ rst time in India in the ﬁ rst Battle of Panipat. *Babur declared Jehad in the Battle of Khanwa. The battle of Khanwa was fought place on March 16, 1527, between Babur and Rana Sanga. Babur defeated Rana Sanga in this Battle and assumed the title of Ghazi. In 1528 AD, Babur took control of Chanderi’s Fort. Medini Rai was killed in the war. *The Battle of Ghaghra took place between Babur and Mahmud Lodi 1529. Babur won the Battle. This was the last battle fought by Babur. *He instituted diﬀ erent systems to run diﬀ erent states to govern his vast empire. *The governance of Badakhshan was given to Humayun, Mir Fakhr Ali, Hindal and Mirza Suleman. The governance of Kabul, Qandahar and Multan was given to Kamran. Mir Yusuf Ali was appointed as governor of Punjab and given the control of Bheera, Lahore, Dipalpur, Sialkot, Sirhind and Hisar-Firoza. *The region of Rajasthan was not included in his empire as it was under the control of various Rajput rulers. *The founder of Mughal Empire, Zahiruddin Muhammad Babur wrote his autobiography containing various events of his life. It was named Tuzuk-i-Babri or Babur Nama. *Babur mentioned two Hindu empires in his autobiography, i.e., Vijayanagara and Mewar. The autobiography written by Babur has an important place among the autobiographies all over the world. Babur Nama is written in the Turkish language. *Abdul Rahim Khanekhana translated Babur Nama in the Persian language by the order of Akbar. *The verse compositions written by Babur, are composed in a Turkish text “Diwan”. He wrote “Mubaiyan’' in a new verse style which is a book of Muslim law. The text Risal-i-Usaj (Khat-i-Baburi) written by Babur is considered as the most innovative style. The Mughal Emperor Babur’s army chief Mir Baqi built the Babri Masjid in Ayodhya. 1. Alam Khan, one of those who invited Babur to invade India was : (a) An uncle of Ibrahim Lodi and a pretender to the throne of Delhi (b) A cousin of Ibrahim Lodi who was ill-treated and expelled from the country (c) The father of Dilawar Khan to whom cruel treatment was meted out by Ibrahim Lodi (d) A high oﬃ cial in Punjab province who was very much discontented with Ibrahim Lodi’s treatment to his tribe I.A.S. (Pre) 2003 Ans. (a) Alam Khan was the uncle of Ibrahim Lodi who invited Babur to invade India. During the fourth Indian campaign of Babur, the relationship between Ibrahim Lodi and Daulat Khan became bad. Ibrahim Lodi ordered Daulat Khan to visit his capital, but Daulat Khan violated his orders and sent his son Dilawar Khan to Babur with a message to help him to dethrone Ibrahim Lodi and enthrone Alam Khan in place of him. It was a golden opportunity for Babur as he already received the invitation of Rana Sanga, the king of Mewar. He was quite assured that the opportunity to win India has come. 2. During the annexation of Afghanistan, who invited Babur to invade India? (a) Ustad Ali (b) Mustafa (c) Daulat Khan (d) Hasan Khan U.P. R.O./A.R.O. (Mains) 2021 Ans. (c) See the explanation of the above question. 3. The Mughal rulers of medieval India were – (a) Persian (Iranian) (b) Afghans (c) Chagatai Turk (d) None of the above U.P. U.D.A./L.D.A. (Pre) 2010 Ans. (c) The Mughal rulers belonged to the Chugatai branch of Turks. This name was derived after the second son of Genghis Khan. He was the ruler of central Asia and Turkistan. 4. Who among the following defeated Babur in the Battle of Sar-e-Pul? (a) Abdullah Khan Uzbeg (b) Shaibani Khan (c) Ubaydullah Khan (d) Jani Begh U.P. Lower Sub. (Pre) 2015 Ans. (b) Shaibani Khan invaded Ferghana in 1501 A.D., defeated Babur at the Sar-e-Pul and occupied Samarqand. Babur ﬂ ed and for three years wandered around the hills of Afghanistan and the plains of Khurasan. He made several attempts to recapture Samarqand but each time suﬀ ered defeat at the hands of Shaibani Khan. Tulghuma technique was used by Shaibani to defeat Babur.

(पूर्व) 1992 उत्तर. (डी) ईस्टर ईसाइयों का एक त्योहार है जो सूली पर चढ़ाए जाने के तीसरे दिन ईसा मसीह के पुनरुत्थान का जश्न मनाता है। 92. कौन सा ईसाई संत पशु-पक्षियों से प्रेम के लिए प्रसिद्ध है? (ए) सेंट पॉल (बी) सेंट थॉमस (सी) सेंट फ्रांसिस ऑफ असीसी (डी) सेंट पीटर एम.पी. पी.सी.एस. (पूर्व) 1997 उत्तर. (सी) असीसी के सेंट फ्रांसिस (1181 या 82-1226 ई.) पक्षियों और जानवरों के प्रति अपने प्रेम के लिए प्रसिद्ध हैं। 93. ईसाइयों का गुड फ्राइडे क्यों मनाया जाता है? (ए) ईसा मसीह की मृत्यु हो गई थी (बी) ईसा मसीह का जन्म हुआ था (सी) ईसा मसीह को सूली पर चढ़ाया गया था (डी) ईस्वी को यूपी में पेश किया गया था। पी.सी.एस. (पूर्व) 1990 उत्तर. (सी) गुड फ्राइडे को ईसा मसीह के शहीद दिवस के रूप में मनाया जाता है। बाइबिल के अनुसार ईसा मसीह को शुक्रवार के दिन फांसी दी गई थी। मुगल वंश : बाबर *मुगल शासक तुर्कों की चगताई शाखा के थे। जिसका नाम मध्य एशिया और तुर्किस्तान के शासक चंगेज खान के दूसरे बेटे के नाम पर पड़ा। *बाबर का पूरा नाम जहीरुद्दीन मुहम्मद बाबर था। उनका जन्म 14 फरवरी, 1483 को फर्गाना में उमर शेख मिर्जा और कुतलुग निगार खानम के घर हुआ था। अपने पिता की मृत्यु के बाद, वह जून, 1494 को ग्यारह वर्ष और चार महीने की नाबालिग अवस्था में फ़रग़ना की गद्दी पर बैठा। *शैबानी खान ने 1501 ई. में फरगाना पर आक्रमण किया और सर-ए-पुल की लड़ाई में बाबर को हराया। बाबर मध्य-एशिया भाग गया। उज़बेगों की "तुलघुमा" तकनीक का इस्तेमाल शायबानी खान ने सर-ए-पुल की लड़ाई में किया था जिसमें बाबर हार गया था। *1504 ई. में काबुल जीतने के बाद बाबर ने अपनी पैतृक उपाधि "मिर्जा" को त्याग दिया और नई उपाधि "पादशाह" धारण की। *आलम खान इब्राहिम लोधी का चाचा था। उसने दिल्ली की गद्दी पर अपना अधिकार जताते हुए बाबर को भारत पर आक्रमण करने के लिए आमंत्रित किया। *1524 ई. में, बाबर के चौथे अभियान के दौरान, दिल्ली के सुल्तान इब्राहिम लोदी और पंजाब के गवर्नर दौलत खान के बीच कड़वाहट पैदा हो गई। इब्राहिम लोदी ने दौलत खान को अपनी राजधानी का दौरा करने का आदेश दिया लेकिन दौलत खान ने उसके आदेशों का उल्लंघन किया और अपने बेटे दिलावर खान को इब्राहिम लोदी को गद्दी से हटाने और उसके स्थान पर आलम खान को सिंहासन पर बैठाने में मदद करने के संदेश के साथ बाबर के पास भेजा। बाबर के लिए यह एक सुनहरा अवसर था क्योंकि उसे मेवाड़ के राजा राणा सांगा का निमंत्रण पहले ही मिल चुका था। उन्हें पूरा विश्वास था कि भारत पर विजय प्राप्त करने का अवसर आ गया है। *पानीपत की पहली लड़ाई 21 अप्रैल, 1526 को बाबर और इब्राहिम लोदी के बीच लड़ी गई थी। बाबर के पास विशिष्ट सैन्य रणनीति थी। बाबर की जीत के पीछे उसका विशाल तोपखाना एक मुख्य कारण था। संख्या में अधिक होने के बावजूद इब्राहिम लोदी की सेना युद्ध हार गई। इस युद्ध में इब्राहीम लोदी मारा गया। परिणामस्वरूप दिल्ली और आगरा तक का संपूर्ण क्षेत्र बाबर के नियंत्रण में आ गया। *27 अप्रैल, 1526 को बाबर ने स्वयं को शासक घोषित किया और भारत में मुगल साम्राज्य की स्थापना की। बाबर ने पानीपत की पहली लड़ाई में तुलुघमा युद्ध तकनीक का इस्तेमाल किया। बाबर की जीत के पीछे उसका विशाल तोपखाना एक मुख्य कारण था। उस्ताद अली कुली ने तोपखाने का नेतृत्व किया और मुस्तफा ने बंदूकधारियों की बटालियन की सराहना की। बाबर की उदारता के कारण उसे "कलंदर" की उपाधि मिली। भारत में पहली बार तोपों का इस्तेमाल पानीपत की पहली लड़ाई में किया गया था। *बाबर ने खानवा के युद्ध में जेहाद की घोषणा की। खानवा का युद्ध 16 मार्च 1527 को बाबर और राणा सांगा के बीच हुआ था। इस युद्ध में बाबर ने राणा सांगा को हराया और गाजी की उपाधि धारण की। 1528 ई. में बाबर ने चंदेरी के किले पर अधिकार कर लिया। युद्ध में मेदिनी राय मारा गया। *घाघरा का युद्ध 1529 में बाबर और महमूद लोदी के बीच हुआ। इस युद्ध में बाबर की जीत हुई। यह बाबर द्वारा लड़ी गई आखिरी लड़ाई थी। *उन्होंने अपने विशाल साम्राज्य पर शासन करने के लिए विभिन्न राज्यों को चलाने के लिए विभिन्न प्रणालियाँ स्थापित कीं। *बदख्शां का शासन हुमायूँ, मीर फखर अली, हिन्दाल और मिर्जा सुलेमान को दिया गया। काबुल, कंधार और मुल्तान का शासन कामरान को दिया गया। मीर यूसुफ अली को पंजाब का गवर्नर नियुक्त किया गया और भीरा, लाहौर, दीपालपुर, सियालकोट, सरहिंद और हिसार-फिरोज़ा का नियंत्रण दिया गया। *राजस्थान का क्षेत्र उनके साम्राज्य में शामिल नहीं था क्योंकि यह विभिन्न राजपूत शासकों के नियंत्रण में था। *मुगल साम्राज्य के संस्थापक जहीरुद्दीन मुहम्मद बाबर ने अपने जीवन की विभिन्न घटनाओं को शामिल करते हुए अपनी आत्मकथा लिखी। इसका नाम तुजुक-ए-बाबरी या बाबरनामा रखा गया। *बाबर ने अपनी आत्मकथा में दो हिंदू साम्राज्यों, विजयनगर और मेवाड़ का उल्लेख किया है। बाबर द्वारा लिखी गई आत्मकथा दुनिया भर की आत्मकथाओं में महत्वपूर्ण स्थान रखती है। बाबरनामा तुर्की भाषा में लिखा गया है। *अकबर के आदेश से अब्दुल रहीम खानेखाना ने बाबरनामा का फारसी भाषा में अनुवाद किया। *बाबर द्वारा लिखी गई पद्य रचनाएँ एक तुर्की ग्रंथ "दीवान" में रचित हैं। उन्होंने एक नई पद्य शैली में "मुबैयान'' लिखा जो मुस्लिम कानून की एक पुस्तक है। बाबर द्वारा लिखित पाठ रिसाल-ए-उसाज (खत-ए-बाबुरी) को सबसे नवीन शैली माना जाता है। मुगल सम्राट बाबर के सेना प्रमुख मीर बाकी ने अयोध्या में बाबरी मस्जिद का निर्माण किया था। 1. बाबर को भारत पर आक्रमण करने के लिए आमंत्रित करने वालों में से एक आलम खान था: (ए) इब्राहिम लोदी का चाचा और दिल्ली के सिंहासन का दावेदार (बी) इब्राहिम लोदी का चचेरा भाई जिसके साथ दुर्व्यवहार किया गया और देश से निकाल दिया गया (सी) दिलावर खान का पिता जिसके साथ इब्राहिम लोदी ने क्रूर व्यवहार किया था (डी) पंजाब प्रांत का एक उच्च अधिकारी जो इब्राहिम लोदी के अपने कबीले के प्रति व्यवहार से बहुत असंतुष्ट था I.A.S. (पूर्व) 2003 उत्तर. (ए) आलम खान इब्राहिम लोदी का चाचा था जिसने बाबर को भारत पर आक्रमण करने के लिए आमंत्रित किया था। बाबर के चौथे भारतीय अभियान के दौरान इब्राहिम लोदी और दौलत खान के बीच संबंध खराब हो गए। इब्राहिम लोदी ने दौलत खान को अपनी राजधानी का दौरा करने का आदेश दिया, लेकिन दौलत खान ने उनके आदेशों का उल्लंघन किया और अपने बेटे दिलावर खान को इब्राहिम लोदी को पद से हटाने और उसके स्थान पर आलम खान को सिंहासन पर बैठाने में मदद करने के संदेश के साथ बाबर के पास भेजा। बाबर के लिए यह एक सुनहरा अवसर था क्योंकि उसे मेवाड़ के राजा राणा सांगा का निमंत्रण पहले ही मिल गया था। उन्हें पूरा भरोसा था कि भारत को जिताने का मौका आ गया है. 2. अफगानिस्तान पर कब्जे के दौरान बाबर को भारत पर आक्रमण करने के लिए किसने आमंत्रित किया? (ए) उस्ताद अली (बी) मुस्तफा (सी) दौलत खान (डी) हसन खान यू.पी. आर.ओ./ए.आर.ओ. (मुख्य) 2021 उत्तर. (सी) उपरोक्त प्रश्न का स्पष्टीकरण देखें। 3. मध्यकालीन भारत के मुगल शासक थे - (ए) फारसी (ईरानी) (बी) अफगान (सी) चगताई तुर्क (डी) उपरोक्त में से कोई नहीं यू.पी. यू.डी.ए./एल.डी.ए. (पूर्व) 2010 उत्तर. (सी) मुगल शासक तुर्कों की चुगताई शाखा के थे। यह नाम चंगेज खान के दूसरे बेटे के नाम पर रखा गया था। वह मध्य एशिया और तुर्किस्तान का शासक था। 4. निम्नलिखित में से किसने सर-ए-पुल की लड़ाई में बाबर को हराया? (ए) अब्दुल्ला खान उज़बेग (बी) शैबानी खान (सी) उबैदुल्ला खान (डी) जानी बेघ यू.पी. निचला उप. (पूर्व) 2015 उत्तर. (बी) शैबानी खान ने 1501 ई. में फरगाना पर आक्रमण किया, सर-ए-पुल में बाबर को हराया और समरकंद पर कब्जा कर लिया। बाबर भाग गया और तीन साल तक अफगानिस्तान की पहाड़ियों और खुरासान के मैदानों में घूमता रहा। उसने समरकंद पर कब्ज़ा करने के कई प्रयास किए लेकिन हर बार उसे शैबानी खान के हाथों हार का सामना करना पड़ा। बाबर को हराने के लिए शैबानी ने तुलघुमा तकनीक का प्रयोग किया था।

According to the Bible, Jesus Christ was hanged on Friday. Mughal Dynasty : Babur *The Mughal rulers belonged to Chagatai branch of Turks. Which derived its name after the second son of Genghis Khan, ruler of central Asia and Turkistan. *The Full name of Babur was Zahiruddin Muhammad Babur. He was born on February 14, 1483 to Umar Shaikh Mirza and Qutlugh Nigar Khanum at Ferghana. After the death of his father, he ascended the throne of Ferghana on June, 1494 as eleven years and four month old minor. *Shaibani Khan invaded Ferghana in 1501 A.D. and defeated Babur at battel of Sar-e-Pul. Babur ﬂ ed to central-Asia. “Tulghuma” technique of Uzbegs was used by Shaybani Khan in the Battle of Sar-e-Pul in which Babur was defeated. *After winning Kabul in 1504 A.D. Babur renounced his ancestral title “Mirza” and assumed new title, “Padshah”. *Alam Khan was the uncle of Ibrahim Lodhi. He invited Babur to invade India, claiming his right to the Delhi throne. *In 1524 A.D., during the 4th campaign of Babur, there was a bitter feud between Sultan Ibrahim Lodi of Delhi and Daulat Khan, the governor of Punjab. Ibrahim Lodi ordered Daulat Khan to visit his capital but Daulat Khan violated his orders and sent his son Dilawar Khan to Babur with a message to help him to dethrone Ibrahim Lodi and enthrone Alam Khan in place of him. It was a golden opportunity for Babur as he had already received the invitation of Rana Sanga, the king of Mewar. He was quite assured that the opportunity to conquer India has come. *The ﬁ rst Battle of Panipat was fought between Babur and Ibrahim Lodi on 21 April, 1526. Babur possessed speciﬁ c military tactics. The vast artillery of Babur was one of the main reasons behind his victory. The army of Ibrahim Lodi lost the battle despite being more in numbers. Ibrahim Lodi was killed in this battle. As a result, the entire area up to Delhi and Agra came under Babur’s control. *Babur declared himself the ruler on April 27, 1526 and founded the Mughal empire in India. Babur used Tulughma war technique in the ﬁ rst battle of Panipat. The huge artillery of Babur was one of the main reasons behind his victory. Ustad Ali Quli led the artillery and Mustafa commended the battalion of gunners. Babur's generosity, earned him the title of “Qalandar”. Cannons were used for the ﬁ rst time in India in the ﬁ rst Battle of Panipat. *Babur declared Jehad in the Battle of Khanwa. The battle of Khanwa was fought place on March 16, 1527, between Babur and Rana Sanga. Babur defeated Rana Sanga in this Battle and assumed the title of Ghazi. In 1528 AD, Babur took control of Chanderi’s Fort. Medini Rai was killed in the war. *The Battle of Ghaghra took place between Babur and Mahmud Lodi 1529. Babur won the Battle. This was the last battle fought by Babur. *He instituted diﬀ erent systems to run diﬀ erent states to govern his vast empire. *The governance of Badakhshan was given to Humayun, Mir Fakhr Ali, Hindal and Mirza Suleman. The governance of Kabul, Qandahar and Multan was given to Kamran. Mir Yusuf Ali was appointed as governor of Punjab and given the control of Bheera, Lahore, Dipalpur, Sialkot, Sirhind and Hisar-Firoza. *The region of Rajasthan was not included in his empire as it was under the control of various Rajput rulers. *The founder of Mughal Empire, Zahiruddin Muhammad Babur wrote his autobiography containing various events of his life. It was named Tuzuk-i-Babri or Babur Nama. *Babur mentioned two Hindu empires in his autobiography, i.e., Vijayanagara and Mewar. The autobiography written by Babur has an important place among the autobiographies all over the world. Babur Nama is written in the Turkish language. *Abdul Rahim Khanekhana translated Babur Nama in the Persian language by the order of Akbar. *The verse compositions written by Babur, are composed in a Turkish text “Diwan”. He wrote “Mubaiyan’' in a new verse style which is a book of Muslim law. The text Risal-i-Usaj (Khat-i-Baburi) written by Babur is considered as the most innovative style. The Mughal Emperor Babur’s army chief Mir Baqi built the Babri Masjid in Ayodhya. 1. Alam Khan, one of those who invited Babur to invade India was : (a) An uncle of Ibrahim Lodi and a pretender to the throne of Delhi (b) A cousin of Ibrahim Lodi who was ill-treated and expelled from the country (c) The father of Dilawar Khan to whom cruel treatment was meted out by Ibrahim Lodi (d) A high oﬃ cial in Punjab province who was very much discontented with Ibrahim Lodi’s treatment to his tribe I.A.S. (Pre) 2003 Ans. (a) Alam Khan was the uncle of Ibrahim Lodi who invited Babur to invade India. During the fourth Indian campaign of Babur, the relationship between Ibrahim Lodi and Daulat Khan became bad. Ibrahim Lodi ordered Daulat Khan to visit his capital, but Daulat Khan violated his orders and sent his son Dilawar Khan to Babur with a message to help him to dethrone Ibrahim Lodi and enthrone Alam Khan in place of him. It was a golden opportunity for Babur as he already received the invitation of Rana Sanga, the king of Mewar. He was quite assured that the opportunity to win India has come. 2. (Pre) 2010 Ans. (c) The Mughal rulers belonged to the Chugatai branch of Turks. This name was derived after the second son of Genghis Khan. He was the ruler of central Asia and Turkistan. 4. Who among the following defeated Babur in the Battle of Sar-e-Pul? (a) Abdullah Khan Uzbeg (b) Shaibani Khan (c) Ubaydullah Khan (d) Jani Begh U.P. Lower Sub. (Pre) 2015 Ans. (b) Shaibani Khan invaded Ferghana in 1501 A.D., defeated Babur at the Sar-e-Pul and occupied Samarqand. Babur ﬂ ed and for three years wandered around the hills of Afghanistan and the plains of Khurasan. He made several attempts to recapture Samarqand but each time suﬀ ered defeat at the hands of Shaibani Khan. Tulghuma technique was used by Shaibani to defeat Babur.

questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (C). Babur mentioned two Hindu State, Vijayanagara and Mewar in his Babur Nama. He writes “when we were at Kabul, Rana Sanga had displayed his loyalty to be present on his behalf and decided that if the honoured king reaches Delhi from this side, I (Rana Sanga) will invade Agra from this side.” This text written by Babur has an important place among the autobiographies all over the world. He wrote 'Mubaiyan' in a new verse style which is a book of Muslim law. The text ‘Risal-i-Usaj (Khat-i-Baburi) written by Babur is considered as the most innovative style.
questions.explanationHi: सही उत्तर: (C) बाबर ने अपने बाबरनामा में दो हिंदू राज्यों, विजयनगर और मेवाड़ का उल्लेख किया है। वह लिखते हैं, "जब हम काबुल में थे, तो राणा सांगा ने उनकी ओर से उपस्थित होने के लिए अपनी वफादारी प्रदर्शित की थी और निर्णय लिया था कि यदि सम्मानित राजा इस तरफ से दिल्ली पहुंचेंगे, तो मैं (राणा सांगा) इस तरफ से आगरा पर आक्रमण करूंगा।" बाबर द्वारा लिखित यह ग्रन्थ विश्व भर की आत्मकथाओं में महत्वपूर्ण स्थान रखता है। अब्दुर्रहीम खान-ए-खाना ने बाबरनामा का फारसी भाषा में अनुवाद किया। बाबर द्वारा लिखी गई पद्य रचनाएँ एक तुर्की ग्रन्थ 'दीवान' में रचित हैं। उन्होंने नई पद्य शैली में 'मुबैयान' लिखा जो मुस्लिम कानून की पुस्तक है। बाबर द्वारा लिखित पाठ 'रिसाल-ए-उसाज (खत-ए-बाबुरी) को सबसे नवीन शैली माना जाता है।

questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (D). It is believed that Babri mosque in Ayodhya was built by Mir Baqi. He was the commandant of Babur. Humayun and Sher Shah *Kamran, Askari and Hindal were the sons of Babur as well as the brothers of Humayun. Humayun was the eldest son of Babur, born in Kabul in 1508 AD. His mother, Maham Begum was related with Shia sect. Gulrukh Begum was the mother of Kamran and Askari whereas Dildar Begam was the mother of Hindal. *Humayun invaded Chunar Fort for the ﬁ rst time in 1532. Humayun besieged this fort for four months after that Sher Khan accepted his supremacy. In addition to this, he invaded Kalinjar in 1531 AD and annexed Raisina Fort in 1532 AD. *The four signiﬁ cant major battles fought by Humayun are as follows- Devara, Chausa, Kanauj and Sirhind. Humayun defeated Afghan rebels on the banks of Gomti at Daurah (Devara) in 1532 AD. *Humayun was defeated by Sher Shah in Battle of Chausa on 26 June 1539, in which a water fetcher named Nizam saved his life. This victory against Humayun increased the prestige and power of Sher Shah (Sher Khan). *On 17 May, 1540 Humayun was defeated by Sher Shah again in the Battle of Kanauj (Bilgram) and Humayun ﬂ ed from one place to the other after this war. *Humayun occupied Delhi again in the Battle of Sirhind on 22 June, 1555. *Farid Khan who later became Sher Shah Suri, got his education from Jaunpur. He left his home in 1494 A.D. and came to Jaunpur for studies which was famous as “Siraj-i-Hind” during that time. *Haji Begum had constructed her husband Humayun's Tomb at Delhi (Deen Panah) in 1565-1572 A.D. it is the ﬁ rst double dome mausoleum of Mughal Architechture. Mirak Mirza Ghiyas was the architect of this tomb. *Sher Shah Suri had a signiﬁ cant role in Revenue reforms, Administrative reforms, Military Reforms and Currency system reforms. He introduced a diﬀ erent system for Bengal province. He divided the Bengal province in Sarkars (district) and appointed a military oﬃ cial as Shiqdar to control. *A non- military oﬃ cial Amir-i-Bengal or 'Amin-i-Bengal' was also appointed for assistance. Qaazi Fajilat was the ﬁ rst man to be appointed for this post. *Sher Shah introduced pure gold, silver and copper coins. His silver 'Rupee' coins weighed 178 grains and copper's 'Daam' weighed 380 grains. The exchange rate of Rupee and Daam was 1 : 64. *Sher Shah died on 22 May 1545 in Kalinjar. Kalinjar campaign was the last campaign of Sher Shah. Kirat Singh was the king of the Kalinjar at that time. Sher Shah Suri was extremely impressed by chivalry and courage of Rajputs during the battle of Marwar and said, “I would have lost the empire just for a handful of millet”. *The tomb of Sher Shah is in the middle of a tank. *This tomb is located at Sasaram in Bihar. * “Purana Quila” was constructed by Sher Shah and Humayun in Delhi. Here, Qila-i-Kuhna mosque was built by Sher Shah. *Sher Shah introduced the system of “Patta” and “Qabuliyat” to help the peasants. The peasants were given “patta” by the central authority in which the share of government was clearly mentioned. The peasants accepted it through “Quabuliyat”. 1. questions.question_en: Who built the Babri mosque established in Ayodhya?
questions.question_hi: अयोध्या में स्थापित बाबरी मस्जिद का निर्माण किसने कराया था?
questions.explanation_en: Correct Answer: (D). It is believed that Babri mosque in Ayodhya was built by Mir Baqi. He was the commandant of Babur. Humayun and Sher Shah *Kamran, Askari and Hindal were the sons of Babur as well as the brothers of Humayun. Humayun was the eldest son of Babur, born in Kabul in 1508 AD. His mother, Maham Begum was related with Shia sect. Gulrukh Begum was the mother of Kamran and Askari whereas Dildar Begam was the mother of Hindal. *Humayun invaded Chunar Fort for the ﬁ rst time in 1532. Humayun besieged this fort for four months after that Sher Khan accepted his supremacy. In addition to this, he invaded Kalinjar in 1531 AD and annexed Raisina Fort in 1532 AD. *The four signiﬁ cant major battles fought by Humayun are as follows- Devara, Chausa, Kanauj and Sirhind. Humayun defeated Afghan rebels on the banks of Gomti at Daurah (Devara) in 1532 AD. *Humayun was defeated by Sher Shah in Battle of Chausa on 26 June 1539, in which a water fetcher named Nizam saved his life. This victory against Humayun increased the prestige and power of Sher Shah (Sher Khan). *On 17 May, 1540 Humayun was defeated by Sher Shah again in the Battle of Kanauj (Bilgram) and Humayun ﬂ ed from one place to the other after this war. *Humayun occupied Delhi again in the Battle of Sirhind on 22 June, 1555. *Farid Khan who later became Sher Shah Suri, got his education from Jaunpur. He left his home in 1494 A.D. and came to Jaunpur for studies which was famous as “Siraj-i-Hind” during that time. *Haji Begum had constructed her husband Humayun's Tomb at Delhi (Deen Panah) in 1565-1572 A.D. it is the ﬁ rst double dome mausoleum of Mughal Architechture. Mirak Mirza Ghiyas was the architect of this tomb. *Sher Shah Suri had a signiﬁ cant role in Revenue reforms, Administrative reforms, Military Reforms and Currency system reforms. He introduced a diﬀ erent system for Bengal province. He divided the Bengal province in Sarkars (district) and appointed a military oﬃ cial as Shiqdar to control. *A non- military oﬃ cial Amir-i-Bengal or 'Amin-i-Bengal' was also appointed for assistance. Qaazi Fajilat was the ﬁ rst man to be appointed for this post. *Sher Shah introduced pure gold, silver and copper coins. His silver 'Rupee' coins weighed 178 grains and copper's 'Daam' weighed 380 grains. The exchange rate of Rupee and Daam was 1 : 64. *Sher Shah died on 22 May 1545 in Kalinjar. Kalinjar campaign was the last campaign of Sher Shah. Kirat Singh was the king of the Kalinjar at that time. Sher Shah Suri was extremely impressed by chivalry and courage of Rajputs during the battle of Marwar and said, “I would have lost the empire just for a handful of millet”. *The tomb of Sher Shah is in the middle of a tank. *This tomb is located at Sasaram in Bihar. * “Purana Quila” was constructed by Sher Shah and Humayun in Delhi. Here, Qila-i-Kuhna mosque was built by Sher Shah. *Sher Shah introduced the system of “Patta” and “Qabuliyat” to help the peasants. The peasants were given “patta” by the central authority in which the share of government was clearly mentioned. The peasants accepted it through “Quabuliyat”. 1. From the following names identify the one who was not the brother of Humayun. (a) Kamran (b) Usman (c) Askari (d) Hindal U.P. Lower Sub. (Pre) 2008 Ans. (b) Kamran, Askari and Hindal were the sons of Babur as well as the brothers of Humayun. Humayun was the eldest son of Babur, born in Kabul in 1508 A.D. His mother, Maham Begum was related to Shia sect. Usman was not his brother. 2. Arrange properly as per dates of four important battles fought by Humayun, the names of battleﬁ elds are given below – (a) Chausa, Devara, Kanauj, Sirhind (b) Devara, Kanauj, Chausa, Sirhind (c) Sirhind, Devara, Chausa, Kanauj (d) Devara, Chausa, Kanauj, Sirhind 41st B.P.S.C. (Pre) 1996 Ans. (d)
